chunks: It is narrated from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said: “Whoever judges concerning two dirhams and errs has committed kufr.”

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.أَبِي بَصِيرٍ: Abū Baṣīr, the transmitter in the sanad
key_terms.حَكَمَ: he judged or issued a ruling
key_terms.دِرْهَمَيْنِ: two dirhams, indicating a very small monetary matter

ai.seo_question: How serious is it to make an erroneous judgment in Islam, even in a small financial matter?
ai.summary: This hadith warns of the extreme gravity of issuing judgment incorrectly, even in a matter as small as two dirhams. It stresses the seriousness of judicial authority and the danger of ruling without truth, knowledge, or correctness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3229 - It is narrated from Abu Basir that

Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad Al-Baqir (as) said:
"Whoever judges in a matter of two dirhams and errs has disbelieved."
